title: Opto-sensing of sotalol using parafilm and poly(methyl methacrylate) micro-plates decorated by silver nanoparticles: state-of-the-art for one-drop pharmaceutical analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12321-12330
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01716E, Paper
Open Access

An innovative optical sensor was developed using silver nanoparticle tablized on parafilm and poly methyl methacrylate for the trace-level detection of sotalol in real sample.
